title: URL harvest with provenance
purpose: Fetch -> normalize -> sha256 -> staged candidate under logs/harvest-<ts>/ (raw.bin, meta.json, candidate.md). External content stays UNTRUSTED; adoption is always an explicit edit citing the hash. Never writes docs.

title: Restart the :5099 dashboard container
purpose: opencode-web is a compose service, not a command. Restarts it so :5099 serves the current checkout, then polls /api/rev until served==HEAD (stale=False) or fails loudly.

title: :4096 recovery probe with ledger logging
purpose: Asserts every :4096 stratum (containers, compose DNS, loopback+mesh TLS edge, dashboard, cert battery, authenticated data plane, session store readonly) with per-signature recovery hints; logs one RECOVERY row per check to observability.db for watchdog polling. Check-only by default; --recover allows one bounded restart+reprobe.

title: Over-budget / denied-model guidance with ledger logging
purpose: Reads session-health risks (every over/warn session, deny-listed free-tier models) and prints the numbered fresh-session guidance; logs ADVISORY rows for watchdog polling. Check-only; exit 1 when the focus is actionable.

title: Deterministic carry-over brief from a transcript
purpose: Builds a paste-ready brief (goal, findings, recent asks, tools, open question) from logs/transcript-<id>.md without a model call; every field passes through redact.mjs. --model only prints the prompt plus the spend command after an ALLOW verdict; it never calls a model.

title: Secrets-at-rest scan with rotation guidance
purpose: Finds secret-shaped lines (deepseek/jev keys, bearer tokens, env assignments) in artifact dirs (logs/, observability, notes). The report is value-free (file:line:kind only). Exit 1 names ./scripts/rotate-api-keys.sh plus the revoke consoles.

title: Rotate DeepSeek + JEV API keys (guided, interactive)
purpose: Browser revoke checklist, .env.local backup (0600), hidden-input new keys, atomic rewrite, container recreate, smoke test. Run in a terminal; the dashboard /manage page is read-only and cannot do this.

title: Periodic threshold monitor with ledger trips
purpose: One sweep: latest-session over-budget/deny-listed trips (T1/T2) plus new gateway-failure lines since cursor (T3); history only reported. Logs ADVISORY rows for watchdog polling. Runs under systemd/opencode-sentinel.timer every 5 min (see sentinel-install).

title: Committed-media size gate
purpose: Fail-closed budgets for tracked media (video <=2MiB, images <=150KiB). Wired into test-hygiene.sh.

title: Contention-evidence snapshot
purpose: Observe-only PSI/CPU/nebula/D-state/swap snapshot to logs/. Run twice ~60s apart and diff. Sends no signals.

title: Recover host->docker port path (sudo)
purpose: Probes mapped ports; if down, restarts the docker daemon after typed YES. Nothing in-repo can fix this path.

title: G4 opt-in proxy routing switch
purpose: Backs up opencode.json, swaps deepseek provider to :4000 proxy, restarts web. --revert restores. Typed YES required.

title: Event ledger (gates + guard verdicts)
purpose: Append-only rows in observability.db ledger (harness GATE_START/GATE, guard.log verdicts, backfill). Queryable history; read via logs.sh --source ledger. Idempotent backfill.

title: Whole-state check
purpose: Every gate (lint, test-hygiene, test-patterns, test-dashboard) + telemetry + cost + TODO in-flight. --json for wrappers.

title: Spend gate (fail closed)
purpose: Refuses (exit 1) unless keys, last gate run, balance and model policy all pass. Run before any paid session.

title: Model catalog + cost policy
purpose: ALLOW / ASK / BLOCK from models.policy.json; also the data behind the /models page.

title: Learned rules (corpus)
purpose: Contrastive (state, action, outcome) rules -> data/observability/learned-rules.json; the guard reads them.

title: Solution library
purpose: Recurring errors and the next action that fixed each -> solutions.json; shown on /explore > patterns.

title: Search (ranked + fuzzy)
purpose: FTS5/bm25 over every part; --fuzzy tolerates typos (edti -> edit).

title: Telemetry
purpose: guard actions, tool errors + traces, events, app log, container log, packet hint.

title: Doc budget
purpose: Token size + content hash of the read-first corpus; unchanged hash = nothing new to re-learn.

title: Blacklist guard self-test
purpose: Proves block/fix/warn plus interpreter-wrapper and pipe-to-shell catches.

title: Tool contract tests
purpose: Asserts every --json tool emits the keys a wrapper reads.

title: Health check
purpose: Ordered tiers; --full adds the Jev proof (Tier 9) and repo gates (Tier 10).

title: UX test (Playwright)
purpose: Asserts the served pages: console clean, no 390px overflow, tabs toggle, overview compact.
commands: pip install playwright && playwright install chromium

title: UX trace (clicks/drags/scrolls + hotspots)
purpose: Logs every click/drag/scroll with screenshots + hotspots into ux.db; --ocr reads the shots back to text. The handoff substrate.

title: Read a screenshot locally
purpose: OCR fallback when image input is unavailable (tesseract / PaddleOCR); searchable via /api/semantic.

title: Cost accounting
purpose: DeepSeek balance + per-session cost + Jev count; bottlenecks, model mix, prompt cache, context budget.

title: GitHub Pages via gh api (no clicking)
purpose: Pages source, Deploy panel dispatch (= allow-once), run watch, URL. Requires gh auth login. Dispatch replaces the Actions UI click.

title: Session health (stalls / blank turns)
purpose: Read-only, browser-independent detection of stalled (running tool) and blank (no text after the last tool) turns straight from opencode.db. Surfaces at /explore ▸ signals and /api/health; --live also reads /session/status.

title: Quirks (symptom → known issue, fuzzy)
purpose: Correlate a symptom with a vendored map of known upstream issues (fuzzy text + typo tolerant), fuzzily search the chat DB, repo code and docs, and show a per-model quirk ledger (tool-error rate + sed/2>/dev/null/subprocess usage). Offline, no network. /api/health carries the correlations and per-model ledger.

title: Live-page CDP probe (real Chrome)
purpose: Attaches to headed google-chrome-stable over CDP and reads rendered state: what the LIVE :5099/:4096 pages show right now (tabs, text, eval, screenshots). Zero-dependency (Node 22 fetch+WebSocket); needs the browser open with --remote-debugging-port. `probe` cross-checks :4096 session ids vs rendered :5099 rows.

title: GitHub Pages panel export (consent-gated)
purpose: Redacted static snapshot (aggregates + session rows, no message text) for Pages. Interactive consent: allow once / allow always / deny. CI assembles committed site-data/panel.json only; the DB never leaves the host.

title: Redact secrets at egress
purpose: Strips key shapes (sk-, apikey_, JWT, Bearer) and NAME=value secrets from exports (/api/export/session, sessions/patterns/guard CSVs); also a stdin filter. Defence in depth for a value already in the transcript.
